name: BMIT Handaq Data Centre
notes: Official Malta Stock Exchange announcement says the Tal-Handaq, Qormi property houses BMIT Group's largest data centre with about 300 racks; DatacenterMap lists BMIT Handaq at 54/55 Triq Manuel Borg Gauci, Qormi and reports 1.2 MW. TVM also reports BMIT data centres in Qormi and SmartCity.

name: Melita Mriehel Secondary Data Centre
notes: Melita's official facilities page describes a secondary data centre in Mriehel connected to the Madliena POP; DatacenterMap places the Melita Mriehel facility under Qormi. Locality assignment is from aggregate source.

name: Gozo Data Centre
notes: MITA procurement fibre-site listing includes 'Gozo Data Centre, St. Francis Square, Victoria, Gozo'; Victoria is also known as Rabat, Gozo. A Government Departments 2010 annual report references work involving the Gozo data centre.

name: CodeGoLab Cloud Platform / Codego Group San Gwann
notes: Official CodeGoLab site markets cloud hosting/virtual server services and lists Codego Group Ltd at 152/NO.9, Triq in-Naxxar, San Gwann. Physical data-centre premises in Saint John/San Gwann were not independently confirmed, so this is retained as unverified local datacenter/cloud activity.
